hud.auth.prompt: [Lobby] Enter your password to enter the world!
command.bug.desc:
Send a bug report with full context to logs/bug-reports.jsonl
Usage: bug <message>
command.bridge.desc: Check StardewBridge connection status to Headless Server
command.connect.desc:
Direct connect to StardewHeadless server
Usage: connect [ip:port] (default: 127.0.0.1:24642)
command.profession.desc:
Choose or check your RPG profession (farmer, miner, fisherman, rancher, forager)
Usage: profession [profession_name]
command.donate.desc:
Donate gold to Village Treasury for communal infrastructure projects
Usage: donate <gold_amount>
command.login.desc:
Login account to StardewHeadless server
Usage: login <password>
command.register.desc:
Register a new account and select permanent profession
Usage: register <password> <farmer|miner|fisherman|rancher|forager>
command.auth.desc:
Authenticate account to server
Usage: auth <password> [profession]
command.smarttools.desc:
Enable or disable SmartTools feature
Usage: smarttools [on|off|toggle]
command.unfreeze.desc:
Force player control recovery if stuck/frozen
Usage: unfreeze
